title: Fantasy Player News
description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Saquon Barkley (stinger) questionable to return
items.desc: Saquon Barkley (stinger) is questionable to return for the Philadelphia Eagles Thursday.
items.impact: Barkley argued with the coaching staff in an attempt to return to the field unsuccessfully, rushing five times for seven yards prior to exiting. Will Shipley takes over in the backfield for head coach Nick Sirianni.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Dalton Kincaid (thumb/ankle) active for Week 12
items.desc: Dalton Kincaid (thumb/ankle) is active for Week 12 for the Buffalo Bills against the Kansas City Chiefs according to Adam Schefter.
items.impact: Kincaid will take the field after logging limited practice activity on a short week, offering quarterback Josh Allen another impactful pass-catching option against the Chiefs Thanksgiving night.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Matthew Stafford held in check in Week 12 win over Packers
items.desc: Matthew Stafford completed 16-of-23 pass attempts for 140 yards and one interception in the Rams' 26-13 Week 12 win over the Packers.
items.impact: Stafford relied on a dominant Rams rushing attack Wednesday night, passing for under 200 yards for the third time in his last five games. The quarterback will hope to get the Los Angeles passing attack back on track with the potential return of wideout Davante Adams for a Week 13 matchup against the Kansas City Chiefs.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Blake Corum dominates on ground in Week 12 win over Packers
items.desc: Blake Corum carried the ball 32 times for 184 yards and one touchdown while also hauling in two of his three targets for 21 yards in the Rams' 26-13 Week 12 win over the Packers.
items.impact: Corum has taken advantage of increased touches out of the Los Angeles backfield of late, finishing with over 50 offensive yards and rushing for one touchdown in each of his last five games. The running back has offered fantasy managers an impactful backfield option while wrestling touches away from Kyren Williams, with a Week 13 matchup against the Kansas City Chiefs up next.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Kyren Williams reaches end zone in Week 12 win over Packers
items.desc: Kyren Williams rushed 12 times for 46 yards and one touchdown while also catching four of his five targets for 19 yards in the Rams' 26-13 Week 12 win over the Packers.
items.impact: Williams maximized his role while being out-touched 34-16 by Blake Corum Wednesday night, reaching the end zone for at least once for the fifth time in his last eight games. The running back faces a stiff test in Week 13 against the Kansas City Chiefs.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Konata Mumpfield leads pass-catchers in Week 12 win over Packers
items.desc: Konata Mumpfield hauled in four of his team-leading five targets for 69 yards in the Rams' 26-13 Week 12 win over the Packers.
items.impact: Mumpfield has taken advantage of a larger pass-catching role of late, logging over 60 receiving yards in each of his last two games. The wideout could be pushed back to a WR2 role with the potential return of Davante Adams entering a Week 13 matchup against the Kansas City Chiefs.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Tyler Higbee (chest) quiet before exiting in Week 12
items.desc: Tyler Higbee caught one of his three targets for 14 yards in the Rams' 26-13 Week 12 win over the Packers.
items.impact: Higbee has made minimal impact on offense of late, recording under 60 receiving yards in each of his last seven games. The tight end's status will need to be monitored after exiting the win with a chest injury, with a Week 13 matchup against the Kansas City Chiefs up next.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Colby Parkinson quiet in Week 12
items.desc: Colby Parkinson caught both of his targets for a loss of one yard in the Rams' 26-13 win over the Packers in Week 12.
items.impact: Parkinson has underwhelmed in the Los Angeles offense of late, finishing with under 40 receiving yards in eight of nine contests. The tight end could be in line for increased snaps heading into a Week 13 contest against the Kansas City Chiefs after both Tyler Higbee and Davis Allen suffered injuries in the Week 12 win.
